parsed.rationale: All six members are empty type-alias-object declarations (fields_or_signature: []) that serve as SwiftUI @main entry points for distinct app targets: WXUISampleApp, WallpaperSampleApp, PlayerHeaderViewApp, PlayerHeaderViewSampleApp, WatchXYC, and WXYCTVApp. The structural similarity (shared_field_count: 1, no differing_slots) is purely a consequence of the SwiftUI App protocol pattern requiring a conforming type with a body property — every SwiftUI app target must declare exactly this shape. Each alias is necessarily scoped to its own module and target; there is no shared logic to extract, and consolidating them would be architecturally meaningless. The coincidence is structural only, not a sign of unintended duplication.
